lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines are visible across the torso. Spacing is approximately 150-200 pixels between primary lines in the mid-section, narrowing significantly toward the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 4th line from the posterior, where the line splits approximately 1/3 down from the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 5, 6, and 7 from the anterior terminate abruptly mid-flank, failing to reach the ventral shaggy fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast white spots are visible on the lateral surface of the hindquarter; one large circular spot on the mid-haunch and one smaller elliptical spot lower towards the stifle.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate, spiral trajectory; they emerge at an approximately 45-degree angle from the frontal bone, curve outward and then inward toward the midline.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the apical tips is approximately 2.2 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 12-15% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white transverse chevron between the eyes, distinct white spots on the lower mandible and cheek, and bright tan/orange 'stocking' coloration on all four limbs below the knee/hock joints.
